$comment: Spin-up survey answers (autonomous/kit/README.md, 9 questions). PROVISIONAL until ratified by the human. Deterministic scaffolding runs FROM this file: change an answer, re-run scaffold, review the diff.
name: antiphon
title: ANTIPHON
one_line: A quantized harmonic companion for Ableton Live: hear a live performance, derive a causal harmonic spine under theta/k hysteresis, emit complementary MIDI on the transport grid.
$comment_dormant: Read by governor/monitor.py (autonomous), per exchange antiphon-001. `review_by` is REQUIRED: dormancy EXPIRES, so this cannot become a permanent way to hide a rotting repo. Live -> DORMANT at INFO and suppresses the STALE activity warning; expired -> DORMANT-EXPIRED at WARN *and* STALE returns, louder than what it muted; omit `review_by` and the whole block is ignored, i.e. the incomplete form fails toward noise, never toward silence. Security/harness checks (UNGATED, NO-CI, LEAK, GAPS) still fire regardless -- a dormant repo can still be insecure.

dormant.reason: three spin-up conditions unmet by design (see spin_up_conditions; DECISIONS D7/D8/D10/D11)

scope_ruling.rule: ANTIPHON_STATUS.md (2026-07-13) outranks antiphon-starter.zip wherever they disagree.
scope_ruling.consequence: Scaffolded the harness around the SURVIVING hysteresis kernel + its pinned tests only. The offline design in the starter zip (tonality_adapter, SUSTAIN/COUNTER/PEDAL policy stubs, AnalysisFrame/ComplementPlan contracts) is superseded by Wend's harmonize mode and was NOT resurrected.

q1_what_is_it.detail: A live device/daemon for Ableton Live (Python core + AbleMCP bridge adapter, later an M4L midiin tap). Not a library; not an offline batch tool -- that is Wend's harmonize mode.

q2_architecture_rung.detail: One resident agent; read-only subagents (Explore/verifier/critic) ad hoc. Chosen by the human, never defaulted. Escalate only when this rung is the demonstrated bottleneck (doctrine: right-size the architecture; Decision 8 -- burden of proof runs against escalation).
q2_architecture_rung.escalation_trigger: A demonstrated bottleneck, e.g. live-regime verification (Layer-E latency/replay runs) becoming the pacing item -- that would earn rung 2 (thread + verifier), not a fleet.

q3_domain_core.answer: The theta/k harmonic hysteresis kernel and all emission policy.
q3_domain_core.detail: Hard exact logic an LLM must never own: interpretation-switching (hold incumbent until challenger clears margin theta for k consecutive frames), transport-grid scheduling, and note selection. Pure, deterministic, seeded; no wall-clock, no I/O in core.
q3_domain_core.boundary: AI/deterministic boundary (D5): Claude agents build and review; they never perform. No AI/LLM call anywhere in the runtime path.

layer_0: leak gate (no machine-absolute paths -- repo is PUBLIC)
no wall-clock in core/ or policies/ (grep gate)
no unseeded randomness anywhere in src/ (grep gate)
hysteresis behavior pinned by 6 unit tests (stdlib unittest, zero-dep)
layer_e: DEFERRED: replay invariant -- a logged live session's causal spine + params + seed, replayed through Wend's voice stage, must reproduce emissions byte-for-byte. The batch tool is the live device's oracle.
DEFERRED: bridge round-trip smoke test + poll-to-commit latency, measured to traces/, non-blocking.

q5_second_implementation.detail: No port-pin module. But the replay invariant makes Wend's offline voice stage a de-facto reference implementation to agree with -- that is an oracle relationship, not a second implementation.

consumes.surface: frozen HarmonicSpine schema + pinned voice stage
consumes.policy: Consume, don't fork. ANTIPHON produces spines with source="live" conforming to the frozen version; it does not define its own contracts.
consumes.status: BLOCKED -- spine schema not yet frozen; brief required before Phase 1.

consumes.surface: analysis slices (key estimate, chord naming, voice-leading distance)
consumes.policy: Pinned library import behind an adapter (D2). New oracle surface = provider-first PR to Tonality, linked consumer pin bump. Never shim locally.

consumes.surface: clip read/write, transport state; later an M4L midiin tap

q7_parallel_audit_thread.detail: Not earned at this size. Consistent with the single-thread rung.

q9_lifespan_autonomy.detail: Human-in-the-loop; agents build and review, never perform. Musical judgment calls are documented and traced, never automated. Governance strictness: standard harness gates + append-only DECISIONS.

stack.dependency_policy: Core stays zero-dep and framework-free (doctrine: pure cores; UI/IO/time in thin adapters). Tests use stdlib unittest. Adding any dependency is a human gate.

spin_up_conditions.$comment: From ANTIPHON_STATUS.md. Scaffolding the repo does NOT satisfy these -- musical feature work stays gated until all three hold.
spin_up_conditions.1_wend_h2_passes: unmet -- the falsifiable claim (harmonization clarifies hearing) must hold on Wend's fixture set first
spin_up_conditions.2_live_regime_needed: unmet -- requires an actual workflow blocked by batch (performing against it, not bouncing files)
spin_up_conditions.3_quantization_ceiling_measured: unmet -- bar-level works today; beat/sub-beat waits on tonality-core slice availability
